bull.b: TTM revenue is about $1.20B, up ~20%, while gross and net margins are ~75% and ~31%. This combination indicates strong monetization and operating leverage, supporting durable earnings capacity as AI and cloud infrastructure demand expands.

Zero debt and $1.25B of cash, equivalents and marketable securities give Astera flexibility to fund product development and capacity without relying on financing. Solid operating cash flow and $277M FCF further support resilience.

PCIe 6 exceeded 50% of Q2 revenue, Scorpio X entered volume production early, and Leo won a hyperscaler design win. These placements broaden content opportunities and align Astera with evolving AI interconnect architectures, supporting multi-year platform growth.

bear.b: Losses in 2022–2024 preceded the sharp 2025-to-TTM profit inflection. Although current margins are strong, this limited profitability history makes earnings durability less proven across demand cycles and raises the risk that recent performance is not yet normalized.

TTM FCF was about $277M, but declined 19.3% year over year; operating and free cash flow were also negative in 2022–2023. This uneven conversion can constrain internally funded investment and signals working-capital or spending sensitivity.

Scorpio's ramp is led by a major hyperscaler, while margins vary by lane count and use case; Q3 gross-margin guidance falls to ~72% from 73.7%. Concentration and mix sensitivity could make growth and profitability dependent on execution by a few programs.
